title: Qurutob (Tajik dried-cheese broth over flatbread with fresh vegetables)

ingredients.name: qurut (dried salty yoghurt cheese balls), or substitute 200 g very dry feta blended with 150 g thick plain yoghurt
thin flatbreads or lavash, or fried layered flatbread (fatir)
small hot green chilli, sliced, optional

steps: Crush the qurut and soak it in the warm water until it softens, then mash or blend it into a smooth, tangy, salty liquid and taste for salt.
Tear the flatbreads into large pieces and arrange them in a deep shallow bowl or platter.
Spoon the cheese liquid slowly over the bread until it is moist but not soggy.
Heat the oil and fry half of the onions until golden and soft.
Spread the tomatoes, cucumber, herbs and the raw onions over the bread, and add the chilli if you like.
Pour the hot onion oil over the top, and serve straight away, eating from the shared dish.

source.note: Original write-up of a traditional preparation, made for World Recipes. Quantities are approximate; adjust to taste.

title: Shakarap (Tajik tomato and onion salad served with pilaf)
steps: Slice the tomatoes and onions as thinly as possible, using a very sharp knife.
Put the onion slices in a bowl, sprinkle with the salt and rub gently to soften them, then pour off any liquid.
Add the tomatoes, pepper and lemon juice or vinegar if you like, and toss lightly.
Leave for 10 minutes so the juices mix, scatter with herbs and serve beside pilaf or grilled meat.
